title: Table per Hierarchy (TPH)
description: Learn TPH strategy with discriminator column for single-table mapping.

data.text: **Table per Hierarchy (TPH)** maps an inheritance hierarchy to **one single database table** with a discriminator column to distinguish between types.

items: One table stores all types in the hierarchy
Uses discriminator column to identify derived type
No JOINs required when querying derived types

data.caption: TPH single table structure
data.definition:
graph TD
    A[Animals Table] --> B[Id, Name]
    A --> C[Discriminator]
    A --> D[Cat: Lives]
    A --> E[Dog: IsGoodBoy]

items: You want a fully normalized schema
Many derived types create lots of nullable columns

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Best for simple queries and frequent derived type queries
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about TPT strategy.
